posts.title: A Past Tense Word
posts.description: Rick Beato just published another one of his long-form interviews . This time, he interviewed Josh Homme. Josh is from Palm Desert, California, where there were no clubs, so his band Kyuss , which he founded when he was 14, played parties outside in the desert. posts.title: Ad Infinitum
posts.description: At Google I/O this week, the company announced the biggest change to Search in 25 years . The ten blue links? Gone. Instead, you get — first at times? soon always? — “generative UI”, an “intelligent search box” with custom interactive widgets, built on the fly by Gemini. posts.title: Lazy and Prompt
posts.description: Chrome 148 shipped this week, and in the release notes you’ll find one of the best things to happen to web performance in a long time: loading="lazy" for <video> and <audio> elements.
